class.name: IfcFacetedBrep
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A faceted B-rep is a simple form of boundary representation model in which all faces are planar and all edges are straight lines. Unlike the B-rep model, edges and vertices are not represented explicitly in the model but are implicitly available through the poly loop entity.
